authority: Decree 253/2026/NĐ-CP art.26(1) (from 1 July 2026): the wage for night work itself is exempt, not only the part paid above the day wage (Circular 111/2013 art.3(1)(i) before). The normal-hour wage of each normal (non-overtime) hour worked between rules.night_window (22:00–06:00) leaves the PIT base; the salary still pays it (an EMPLOYER line is not paid again), and the night premium (NIGHT_WORK) and night overtime are already outside PIT. Decree 145/2020 art.56: the night-work wage is the normal hour wage × night hours plus at least 30%. https://datafiles.chinhphu.vn/cpp/files/vbpq/2026/7/253m-ndcp.signed.pdf Only a normal working day’s night hours (day_type WORK, not a holiday): night hours on a rest day or holiday are paid inside REST_DAY_OVERTIME and HOLIDAY_WORK, which already count toward nothing (Decree 253/2026 art.26(1)), so they are not taken out of PIT a second time.
